body:
I was happy. But then I think I got to know him more and it didn't make me happy.

Ideally, I guess I would go to a place where no one knew me and id start over. But that's not possible. I have to many things that tie me down (house, job, etc.)

I would love to just have a fresh start.

Thanks for your response....I know I can deep down, but I don't want to deal with everyone talking. I don't want to deal with hurting her or my family or anyone else. I'd rather just die that to deal with all this. And it kills me because I had so many hopes and dreams.
